result.reason: The redline adds the preferred frequency, notice, business-hours, auditor-confidentiality, and 5% cost-shifting protections, but it does not prohibit direct access to Licensee systems. It also leaves the original subsection intact, creating duplicative and potentially inconsistent scope language: the new text limits review to fee-relevant records, while subsection (b) permits review for compliance with all Agreement terms. The 24-month look-back, contingent-fee restriction, and mandatory overpayment refund with interest exceed what is required and introduce additional commercial changes. The unresolved duplication and scope conflict materially reduce drafting quality.
